questions.subject: Science
questions.stem:
Assertion (1): A student puts 20 mL of sugar solution and a pinch of yeast granules in a test tube, plugs the mouth of the test tube with cotton, and keeps it undisturbed in a warm place. After 1 to 2 hours, a drop of this mixture seen under a compound microscope shows small, round outgrowths, called buds, emerging from the parent yeast cells.
Reason (2): In organisms such as hydra, repeated cell division at a specific site on the parent body produces a small outgrowth called a bud, and this bud enlarges and then separates from the parent to live independently. (A) Both assertion and reason are correct and the reason explains the assertion. (B) Both assertion and reason are correct but the reason does not explain the assertion. (C) The assertion is correct but the reason is incorrect. (D) Both assertion and reason are incorrect.

answerScheme.modelAnswer: Both assertion and reason are correct and the reason explains the assertion.
